BucketsConfig.description: Histogram bucket boundaries (Req 2.11). Shape is checked in :func:`cross_field_errors`.
BucketsConfig.title: BucketsConfig

BudgetConfig.description: A key's ``default_budget`` (Phase 4 Req 5.2). ``max_cost`` is in the Price_Table currency.
BudgetConfig.title: BudgetConfig

ClientLimitsConfig.description: ``client_limits`` (Phase 4 Req 1.1). Overrides are matched by Key_Fingerprint.
ClientLimitsConfig.title: ClientLimitsConfig

ClientOverride.description: Settings for one Key_Fingerprint. A field left unset (``None``) inherits the default.
ClientOverride.title: ClientOverride

HttpFetchConfig.description: ``http_fetch``: GET only, https only, the allowed hosts only (Phase 6 Req 5.9).
HttpFetchConfig.title: HttpFetchConfig

PricingConfig.description: Optional Price_Table (Req 10.1). Duplicate pairs are checked in :func:`cross_field_errors`.
PricingConfig.title: PricingConfig

PricingEntryConfig.description: One Price_Table entry as read from Agent_Config (Req 10.1).
PricingEntryConfig.title: PricingEntryConfig

SandboxConfig.description:
The Code_Worker's sandbox (Phase 6 Req 6.1, 6.4, 6.5): off by default.

Only the container CLI, an image, an optional OCI runtime by name and five bounded limits can be set. There is no
setting for the network, mounts, devices, privileges, the user or the runtime's socket: ``extra="forbid"`` makes
each of them a configuration error rather than something silently ignored.
SandboxConfig.title: SandboxConfig

TenantConfig.description:
One entry of the ``tenants`` list (Phase 5 Req 1, 4, 7).

``max_active_requests`` here is the Tenant_Quota (0 = none), distinct from the per-key field of ``settings``.
TenantConfig.title: TenantConfig

TenantKeyConfig.description: One key of a tenant, by Key_Fingerprint (not a secret), with the Scopes it holds (Phase 5 Req 1.1).
TenantKeyConfig.title: TenantKeyConfig

TenantSettings.description:
The Client_Settings layer of a tenant, between ``client_limits.default`` and a key override (Req 4.1, 4.2).

The fields of :class:`ClientOverride` without the fingerprint; a field left unset (``None``) inherits.
TenantSettings.title: TenantSettings

ToolsConfig.description: The tools a Worker lets the model call (Phase 6 Req 5.3). Nothing is enabled by default.
ToolsConfig.title: ToolsConfig

TransportsConfig.description: Transport implementation names, resolved by the transport loader (Req 8.4).
TransportsConfig.title: TransportsConfig

UsageConfig.description: ``usage`` (Phase 5 Req 6.6): how long each per-day Usage_Rollup lives.
UsageConfig.title: UsageConfig

WebhookConfig.description: Webhook_Sender settings (Phase 4 Req 8.6). ``workers`` 0 disables the sender on this replica.
WebhookConfig.title: WebhookConfig

config_schema.description: Fully validated Agent_Config for one agent process.
config_schema.title: AgentConfig
